verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a REST and GraphQL API that can create and update Person and Company records, including batch create and upsert (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-22, twenty-docs-25), and lists an MCP server on every plan (twenty-docs-32). Its native AI agents can enrich records from external sources and run multi-step tasks within role-scoped permissions (twenty-docs-5, twenty-docs-56, twenty-docs-71), and one community user said the REST API worked ok (twenty-comm-1). missing for 10: explicit documentation of assigning a record owner via API or agent, any detail on the MCP server's tools beyond a pricing-table line, an end-to-end lead-enrichment walkthrough, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent or MCP flow.
